protocol.text_encoder: Existing frozen q4 text embeddings, 88 candidates, unchanged
protocol.license: Original Google model Apache-2.0; ONNX repository links to original and has no separate license field
protocol.preprocessing: Whole RGB image warped to 224x224, PIL bilinear, x/127.5-1, CHW; unchanged
protocol.selection_policy: Strict labels: >=90% development precision among >=10 accepted. Within each variant maximize correct accepted, precision, stricter margin, stricter minimum. Across variants maximize correct accepted, precision, then smaller bytes. Freeze chosen variant and thresholds before running any confirmation input.
protocol.development_scope: 96 public images indices0..11, includes previous research test photos; not independent validation
protocol.confirmation_scope: 40 next original-photo-hash samples indices12..16, never used for this selection
protocol.coarse_policy: Families only reported separately, never used to select model, thresholds, or modify ranking margin
protocol.fp16_optimization: Basic graph optimization: default optimization failed on ORT1.23.2 with a SimplifiedLayerNormFusion cast-reference initialization error; recorded in precision-run-initial-error.log before any successful prediction

limits: Small public source sample with uncertain annotations and unknown pretraining overlap; no private images, no Brazilian scenes, no user validation. Classification latency excludes camera, speech and network.
